001: I need a room for two nights, please.
Of course! Do you prefer a room with a view of the beach?
That would be great, if it's not much more expensive.
The difference is small, just forty reais per night.
Then that works. Is breakfast included?
Yes, breakfast is included in the nightly rate.
002: Good afternoon! I have a reservation for this weekend.
Let me check the system. What's your name?
It's Fernanda Almeida, I booked through the website.
I found it here. It's a double room for three nights, right?
That's right. Do you have parking at the hotel?
We do, but you have to pay an extra fee per day.
003: Do you still have rooms available for tomorrow?
Let me see... We have a single room available.
How much is the nightly rate for that room?
The nightly rate is two hundred and twenty reais.
Does that price include access to the pool?
Yes, the pool and the gym are included.
004: Does the room I booked have air conditioning?
Yes, all of our rooms have air conditioning.
That's great! And what time is check-out?
Check-out is at noon, but you can request a late check-out.
How does that late check-out work?
You can leave until three in the afternoon by paying half the nightly rate.
005: I'd like to make a reservation for the holiday.
For how many people and how many nights?
There will be four people, and we'll stay two nights.
In that case, I recommend booking two double rooms.
Do you offer any discount for groups?
For four people, I can give you a ten percent discount.
006: Does the room have free Wi-Fi?
We have free Wi-Fi in all areas of the hotel.
And what time does breakfast start?
Breakfast is served from six thirty to ten o'clock.
Perfect. Can I check in earlier tomorrow?
If the room is ready, there's no problem at all.
007: I need to cancel my reservation for next week.
I'm sorry to hear that. What's the reservation number?
The number is one hundred and twenty-three, under Gabriel's name.
I found your reservation. Is there a fee for cancellation?
I hope not, I canceled a week in advance.
You're within the deadline, so you won't have any fee.
008: Do you have rooms with two twin beds?
Yes, we do, but there are only two of those rooms left.
I need one for next Saturday.
I'll book it for you right now. Any preference for floor?
I prefer a higher floor, if possible.
I'll put you on the eighth floor, with a beautiful view.
009: Does the hotel offer transportation to the airport?
We offer a transfer service, for an additional cost.
How much does the transfer to the airport cost?
It costs eighty reais per person, with flexible scheduling.
And how long does the trip to the airport take?
On average, forty minutes, depending on the traffic.
010: I'd like to extend my stay for one more night.
No problem! Let me check if the room is available.
If it's not, can I move to another room?
The room is available, so you can stay in the same one.
That's great! I'll pay for the extra night now.
Perfect, I'll prepare the new bill for you.
